title: Imam Mosque (Shah Mosque), Isfahan
summary: The Shah Mosque in Isfahan, Iran, is topped by a double-shell dome with a 22.65 m span and a height of 52 m, according to a structural study published by the SAHC masters network. That study dates its construction from 1611 to 1629; a design-canon page says it was largely complete by 1629 with finishing later, and that UNESCO inscribed it in 1979.

uncertainty.note: Start is 1611 on both pages. 1629 is the completion year given by SAHC; the second page says largely completed by 1629, finished later. End is the present: the mosque stands.

as_recorded.value: The construction of Shah Mosque started in 1611 and was completed in 1629.
